On a pleasant afternoon, a short pause was brought to the arrivals lead Incident Report: Routine Companion Animal Review at Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk received a walk-in concern from a passenger who appeared unsettled about the condition and transfer plan for a pet arriving on a connecting service. The matter was brought forward in a calm but urgent manner and was handled at the counter with the arrivals lead present. The passenger stated that the carrier looked disturbed after handoff and asked for immediate review before leaving the terminal area.

The records aide checked the booking file, the pet acceptance note, and the transfer log against the visible carrier tag and manifest details. The pet was observed to be alert, with no clear sign of injury, but the passenger remained anxious and requested reassurance. Following the desk procedure, the concern was raised step by step to the senior coordinator, who listened carefully and confirmed that the carrier had been moved under standard handling controls. The senior coordinator also reviewed the arrival path and advised that the pet be moved to a quieter holding position for a more settled reassessment.

Staff then contacted the ground handler and obtained confirmation of the transfer sequence. The passenger was informed of the findings in plain terms and was offered a seat nearby while the pet was checked again. Water was made available, the carrier was kept closed and secure, and the pet was monitored until the family was ready to proceed. No injury was recorded, and no further escalation was required after the second review.

Follow-up instructions were entered into the desk record for later reference, and the passenger was advised to report any change in the pet's condition after departure. The event closed without disruption to other arrivals, and staff remained alert for any related concern. Companion Animal Travel Desk
